vb_textbox.text: I randomly chose the first colours, red and purple, and continued to select them until the mushroom count went below 3. At this point, I switched to the brown and blue/grey until likewise they also went below 3. There are times when you are constantly obtaining large mushroom counts and feel tempted to switch; don't bother. Similarly sometimes you would get a low number (zero in fact) but I continued with the same technique anyway and found that often enough it would turn around. Fingers crossed you can have some success with the game
